relations.subject: n1ql:array-remove
relations.evidence: This function cannot be used to remove NULL values from an array as it uses an equality predicate when evaluating the array elements to remove. Since NULL does not equal NULL, such values are not matched and remain in the array. To remove NULL values, use the [Array Collection Operator](collectionops.md#array) instead.
